TextView.android:text:
The AJC Proof-of-Work (PoW) Reward Program is the mining reward system of the AJC blockchain ecosystem. It enables users to earn AJC cryptocurrency by contributing their device's computing power to secure the blockchain, validate transactions, and create new blocks.

 The program supports both Solo Mining and Pool Mining. Solo miners work independently and receive the full block reward when they successfully mine a block. Pool miners combine their computing power with other miners, increasing the chances of finding blocks. When a pool successfully mines a block, rewards are distributed fairly based on each miner's contribution, measured by valid shares submitted during the mining process.

 To ensure network security and fairness, mining rewards are released only after a mined block has received the required number of blockchain confirmations. Pending rewards remain locked until confirmation is complete, after which they are automatically credited to the miner's wallet.

 The AJC PoW Reward Program includes dynamic mining difficulty adjustment, hashrate tracking, mining statistics, battery protection, background mining support, and anti-fraud validation mechanisms to maintain a secure, efficient, and decentralized mining network.

 Its goal is to encourage active participation in the AJC blockchain while rewarding honest miners for helping maintain the integrity, decentralization, and long-term security of the network.

There are several ways to maximize your AJC mining rewards:

1. Keep Mining Consistently – The longer your miner stays online, the more shares you contribute and the greater your earning potential.

2. Increase Your Hashrate – Devices with better CPU performance can process more hashes per second, increasing the likelihood of earning rewards.

3. Join a Mining Pool – Pool mining combines the computing power of many miners, resulting in more frequent block discoveries and steady reward distributions based on your contribution.

4. Maintain a Stable Internet Connection – A reliable connection ensures your mining shares are submitted successfully without delays or rejection.

5. Reduce Rejected Shares – Keep your app updated and maintain a stable device to minimize invalid or stale shares, improving your effective rewards.

6. Mine During Longer Sessions – Longer uninterrupted mining sessions generally produce more valid shares and better overall earnings.

7. Use Devices Efficiently – Mine on devices with sufficient battery, good cooling, and adequate processing power for optimal performance.

8. Refer New Miners (Optional) – If the AJC referral program is enabled, inviting new users can earn you additional referral bonuses.

9. Stay Active in the AJC Ecosystem – Participate in community events, special campaigns, and bonus reward programs when available.

10. Keep Your Wallet Secure – Ensure your wallet is backed up and protected so your earned AJC remains safe.

Note: Mining rewards depend on factors such as your hashrate, network difficulty, pool performance (if applicable), and successful block confirmations. Rewards are distributed only after mined blocks have been confirmed on the blockchain.
